task.title: Charging Devices on FM Transmitter
task.shortdesc: This device includes two separate USB port for quick-charging mobile/electronic devices.

prereq.p: The only prerequisite needed for this task is having a Type-C or USB-A charging cable.

context.p: When wanting to charge your devices you can use both USB type ports for quick charging.The quick-charging feature can only be activated by using only one of the quick-charging ports at a time.

step.cmd: Locate the two quick-charging ports on the device. (QC 3.0 and PD USB-C) Image of charging ports labeled on transmitter
Plug in the charging cable (not-included with device) into compatible charging port. Image of charging cable plugged into transmitter
Plug charging cable into mobile/electronic device. Image of charging cable plugged into mobile device

result.p: The FM transmitter now can serve as a charger for mobile devices.The Audio USB Flash Drive Port can be used for charging, but this port has no quick-charging features.
